source.note: The registry count is installable UI components. Examples are additional official variants/demos and are listed separately.

components.name: magic-card
components.title: Magic Card
components.description: A spotlight effect that follows your mouse cursor and highlights borders on hover.
components.reviewDescription: Pointer-tracking spotlight inside a card; supports a gradient or orb glow treatment.
components.interaction: Move the pointer across the surface to move the highlight; choose gradient or orb mode.

motionProfile.mechanism: A radial spotlight follows pointer coordinates; spring values smooth the lag and the glow fades in on hover.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Interactive while hovered; no autonomous loop.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: android
components.title: Android
components.description: A mockup of an Android device.
components.reviewDescription: Android device frame for presenting supplied app media.
components.interaction: Pass an image or video source and size the frame; the component itself does not simulate an app.

motionProfile.mechanism: Static device bezel around caller-supplied image or video.
motionProfile.trigger: None; media plays only if the supplied media is animated.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Presentation frame, not a simulated interface.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: warp-background
components.title: Warp Background
components.description: A card with a time warping background effect.
components.reviewDescription: A card surface with a perspective grid that bends and recedes like a time-warp tunnel.
components.interaction: Place content inside the card; the animated grid provides the surrounding depth effect.

motionProfile.mechanism: Perspective grid/card field with vertical elements traveling through the scene on repeating linear paths.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Continuous loop; content is slotted above the effect.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: line-shadow-text
components.title: Line Shadow Text
components.description: A text component with a moving line shadow.
components.reviewDescription: Text with a moving linear shadow that travels across the letterforms.
components.interaction: Render the text and let the configured animation sweep the shadow.

motionProfile.mechanism: CSS background-position moves a narrow line-shadow texture across the text.
motionProfile.lifecycle: 15-second linear infinite sweep.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: aurora-text
components.title: Aurora Text
components.description: A beautiful aurora text effect
components.reviewDescription: Text filled with a soft, shifting aurora color field.
components.interaction: The color field animates continuously behind the clipped text.

motionProfile.mechanism: Clipped gradient background shifts position while the color field rotates and scales.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Eight-second ease-in-out loop, alternating direction.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: morphing-text
components.title: Morphing Text
components.description: A dynamic text morphing component for Magic UI.
components.reviewDescription: Cycles between strings by crossfading two text layers while blurring the outgoing and incoming words.
components.interaction: Provide alternate words or phrases; the component transitions between them automatically.

motionProfile.mechanism: Two text layers crossfade while blur changes, making one phrase resolve into the next.
motionProfile.trigger: Starts on mount; cycles through provided strings.
motionProfile.lifecycle: RAF-driven cycle; default morph 1.5 seconds plus 0.5-second pause.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: scroll-progress
components.title: Scroll Progress
components.description: Animated Scroll Progress for your pages
components.reviewDescription: A thin progress indicator tied to the reader’s scroll position.
components.interaction: Scroll the page to move the indicator from start to completion.

motionProfile.mechanism: Scale/position of the progress bar is bound to page scroll progress.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Tracks scroll continuously; no timer.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: lens
components.title: Lens
components.description: A interactive component that enables zooming into images, videos and other elements.
components.reviewDescription: A magnifying lens that enlarges the region under a pointer over supplied content.
components.interaction: Move the pointer or touch across the media to move the zoom lens.

motionProfile.mechanism: A clipped magnified copy moves beneath a circular/shape lens; the lens enters and exits with opacity and scale.
motionProfile.trigger: Pointer move; keyboard controls are also provided.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Visible while active over the media; no autonomous loop.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: pointer
components.title: Pointer
components.description: A component that displays a pointer when hovering over an element
components.reviewDescription: A custom pointer element that follows a target element with a smooth spring.
components.interaction: Move the pointer inside the wrapped area; enter and leave control its visibility.

motionProfile.mechanism: Custom pointer follows the pointer position with Motion values and enter/leave visibility transitions.
motionProfile.trigger: Pointer enters, moves within, and leaves the wrapped target.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Interactive; spring tracking rather than timed looping.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: smooth-cursor
components.title: Smooth Cursor
components.description: A customizable, physics-based smooth cursor animation component with spring animations and rotation effects

props.name: springConfig
props.type: { damping: number stiffness: number mass: number restDelta: number }

components.reviewDescription: A free-moving cursor graphic that follows pointer movement with spring easing and rotation.
components.interaction: Move the pointer across the page to see the lagging, softened follow motion.

motionProfile.mechanism: Custom cursor follows pointer input with spring smoothing, orientation response, and visibility/fade handling.
motionProfile.trigger: Pointer movement; inactivity can return it to its resting state.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Interactive; requestAnimationFrame processes pointer movement.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: progressive-blur
components.title: Progressive Blur
components.description: The Progressive Blur component adds a smooth blur gradient effect to scrollable content, indicating more content below or above.
components.reviewDescription: A blur gradient at the edge of a scrollable region, signaling more content beyond the visible edge.
components.interaction: Scroll the clipped content; the blur masks the overflow edge.

motionProfile.mechanism: Layered CSS blur masks soften the edge of a clipped scroll region.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Static masks; perceived exposure changes as content moves underneath.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: neon-gradient-card
components.title: Neon Gradient Card
components.description: A beautiful neon card effect
components.reviewDescription: A card with a configurable animated gradient border or glow treatment.
components.interaction: Hover or view the card while its border treatment animates; the effect is decorative.

motionProfile.mechanism: Two CSS gradient layers shift their background position to animate the border and glow.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Three-second alternating loop.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: meteors
components.title: Meteors
components.description: A meteor shower effect.
components.reviewDescription: A field of short streaks that travel diagonally across a background.
components.interaction: The meteor streaks animate automatically behind the supplied content.

motionProfile.mechanism: Each streak rotates to its configured angle, translates across the background, then fades out.
motionProfile.trigger: Starts on mount with per-meteor delays.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Five-second linear repeating trajectories.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: grid-pattern
components.title: Grid Pattern
components.description: A background grid pattern made with SVGs, fully customizable using Tailwind CSS.
components.reviewDescription: A static SVG grid pattern that can be clipped or positioned as a background.
components.interaction: Set grid size and color through props/classes; there is no interaction.

motionProfile.mechanism: Static SVG grid lines.
motionProfile.lifecycle: No motion.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: striped-pattern
components.title: Striped Pattern
components.description: A background striped pattern made with SVGs, fully customizable using Tailwind CSS.
components.reviewDescription: A static SVG stripe pattern for a restrained background texture.
components.interaction: Configure the stripe size, color, and placement; there is no interaction.

motionProfile.mechanism: Static SVG diagonal stripe paths.
motionProfile.lifecycle: No motion.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: interactive-grid-pattern
components.title: Interactive Grid Pattern
components.description: A interactive background grid pattern made with SVGs, fully customizable using Tailwind CSS.
components.reviewDescription: A grid whose cells respond to pointer entry with a localized highlight.
components.interaction: Move the pointer across cells to trigger the hover response.

motionProfile.mechanism: SVG cells transition fill/stroke when the pointer enters; leaving clears the active cell.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Hover-driven; fill response is quick and reset eases more slowly.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: dot-pattern
components.title: Dot Pattern
components.description: A background dot pattern made with SVGs, fully customizable using Tailwind CSS.
components.reviewDescription: A static SVG dot field with adjustable spacing and color.
components.interaction: Set spacing and dot color; there is no interaction.

motionProfile.mechanism: SVG dots are static by default; optional glow mode pulses each dot with its own randomized duration and delay.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Glow dots loop with reverse repeat; default off.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: flickering-grid
components.title: Flickering Grid
components.description: A flickering grid background made with SVGs, fully customizable using Tailwind CSS.
components.reviewDescription: A grid of cells that flicker with randomized opacity over time.
components.interaction: The cell shimmer runs automatically; tune density, colors, and flicker.

motionProfile.mechanism: Canvas cells receive randomized opacity changes to create an irregular flicker.
motionProfile.trigger: Starts only while the component is in the viewport.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Ambient canvas updates; pauses work outside the viewport.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: hero-video-dialog
components.title: Hero Video Dialog
components.description: A hero video dialog component.
components.reviewDescription: A video preview that opens into a modal video player.
components.interaction: Activate the preview button to open the dialog; close it to return to the page.

motionProfile.mechanism: Click opens a video dialog; configurable entrance/exit variants move, scale, or fade the overlay and player.
motionProfile.trigger: Click preview; close or escape to dismiss.
motionProfile.lifecycle: One transition per open/close; supplied video playback is separate.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: code-comparison
components.title: Code Comparison
components.description: A component which compares two code snippets.
components.reviewDescription: A side-by-side code comparison with highlighted additions and removals.
components.interaction: Select or inspect the two versions; line changes are styled as a diff.

motionProfile.mechanism: Static side-by-side code; hovering a side focuses its changed lines while dimming/blurring the others.
motionProfile.lifecycle: 300 ms CSS focus transition; no autonomous motion.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: script-copy-btn
components.title: Script Copy Button
components.description: Copy code to clipboard
components.reviewDescription: A code-install helper with package-manager command choices and copy feedback, documented in Magic UI v3.
components.interaction: Choose a package manager command and activate Copy; current implementation source is no longer in the public registry.

motionProfile.mechanism: Official v3 docs describe a copy control with package-manager command choices and copy feedback; source is no longer in the current registry.
motionProfile.trigger: Click copy or choose a package command.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Action feedback only; implementation animation cannot be source-verified.
motionProfile.evidence: official v3 docs only; current implementation source unavailable

components.name: marquee
components.title: Marquee
components.description: An infinite scrolling component that can be used to display text, images, or videos.
components.reviewDescription: A continuously moving horizontal track for text, logos, or media.
components.interaction: The track loops automatically and can pause or respond to hover depending on configuration.

motionProfile.mechanism: Duplicated track translates horizontally or vertically to form a seamless ticker.
motionProfile.trigger: Starts on mount; optional hover pause.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Continuous linear loop; configurable direction, duration, gap, and vertical mode.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: glyph-matrix
components.title: Glyph Matrix
components.description: An animated grid of subtly shifting glyphs with fade effect and theme support.
components.reviewDescription: A field of changing characters arranged in a grid with fading transitions.
components.interaction: Glyphs update automatically; theme and density affect the visual field.

motionProfile.mechanism: Canvas redraws a grid of glyphs that change over time with fading and theme-aware color.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Continuous canvas animation; density and glyph palette configure the field.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: globe
components.title: Globe
components.description: An autorotating, interactive, and highly performant globe made using WebGL.
components.reviewDescription: An interactive WebGL globe with auto-rotation and pointer drag.
components.interaction: Drag to rotate; the globe also turns automatically when idle.

motionProfile.mechanism: WebGL globe rotates automatically; pointer drag adjusts its rotation and changes the cursor to grabbing.
motionProfile.trigger: Auto-rotation on mount; pointer drag temporarily controls orientation.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Continuous WebGL render; fades in after initialization.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: shimmer-button
components.title: Shimmer Button
components.description: A button with a shimmering light which travels around the perimeter.
components.reviewDescription: A button with a moving light that traces or crosses its surface.
components.interaction: The shimmer animates on the button; activation follows normal button behavior.

motionProfile.mechanism: A sheen travels across the button while a conic spark rotates around it.
motionProfile.trigger: Starts on mount; press gives a slight downward active state.
motionProfile.lifecycle: CSS shimmer and rotation repeat continuously.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: tweet-card
components.title: Tweet Card
components.description: A card that displays a tweet with the author's name, handle, and profile picture.
components.reviewDescription: A formatted social post card showing author identity and post content.
components.interaction: Render supplied post data; it is a static content presentation.

motionProfile.mechanism: Static embedded post content; links get subtle hover color/scale feedback.
motionProfile.lifecycle: No card-level entrance or ambient animation.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: client-tweet-card
components.title: Client Tweet Card
components.description: A client-side version of the tweet card that displays a tweet with the author's name, handle, and profile picture.
components.reviewDescription: A client-rendered social post card with author and post content.
components.interaction: Render supplied post data in the browser; it is a static content presentation.

motionProfile.mechanism: Client-rendered version of the same static embedded post content.
motionProfile.lifecycle: No card-level entrance or ambient animation.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: bento-grid
components.title: Bento Grid
components.description: Bento grid is a layout used to showcase the features of a product in a simple and elegant way.
components.reviewDescription: A responsive grid layout whose tiles also animate their icon, title, and supporting copy on hover.
components.interaction: Hover a tile; the title/icon shift and supporting text slides into view.

motionProfile.mechanism: On hover, the icon shrinks, title block shifts upward, and hidden supporting text slides/fades into view.
motionProfile.trigger: Pointer hover on a tile; mobile layout keeps content visible.
motionProfile.lifecycle: 300 ms transitions; no autonomous motion.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: particles
components.title: Particles
components.description: Particles are a fun way to add some visual flair to your website. They can be used to create a sense of depth, movement, and interactivity.
components.reviewDescription: A pointer-responsive particle field with configurable movement and density.
components.interaction: Move the pointer through the canvas to disturb or guide particles.

motionProfile.mechanism: Canvas particles drift and respond to pointer position/force; the field is recalculated through an animation loop.
motionProfile.trigger: Starts on mount; pointer movement influences the field.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Continuous canvas motion; configurable count, speed, size, and interaction.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: number-ticker
components.title: Number Ticker
components.description: Animate numbers to count up or down to a target number
components.reviewDescription: A number that counts or rolls to a target value when it enters view.
components.interaction: Scroll it into view to trigger the count-up or count-down animation.

motionProfile.mechanism: A spring-driven number interpolates from a start value to the target.
motionProfile.trigger: Runs once when the element enters view, after a short delay.
motionProfile.lifecycle: One count-up/count-down per mount/in-view event.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: ripple
components.title: Ripple
components.description: An animated ripple effect typically used behind elements to emphasize them.
components.reviewDescription: Concentric circles pulse in place by scaling and changing opacity; they do not expand from a click point.
components.interaction: The background pulse runs continuously; use Ripple Button for click-originating expanding rings.

motionProfile.mechanism: Concentric circles pulse in place by scaling inward/outward with opacity; they do not expand outward as click ripples.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Repeating CSS pulse; duration is configurable.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: retro-grid
components.title: Retro Grid
components.description: An animated scrolling retro grid effect
components.reviewDescription: A perspective grid that scrolls toward a horizon in a retro-futurist style.
components.interaction: The grid moves continuously; color and perspective set the mood.

motionProfile.mechanism: WebGL shader renders a perspective floor grid with animated depth/position.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Frame-by-frame render; IntersectionObserver pauses work offscreen.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: animated-list
components.title: Animated List
components.description: A list that animates each item in sequence with a delay. Used to showcase notifications or events on your landing page.
components.reviewDescription: Reveals supplied children one at a time, keeping earlier children visible as the list grows.
components.interaction: A timer adds the next child with a spring scale and opacity entrance; it stops after the final child.

motionProfile.mechanism: The list accumulates supplied children one by one; each new child springs from scale zero and fades in while earlier children stay visible.
motionProfile.trigger: A timer reveals the next child; the default delay is one second.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Finite sequence; it stops after the last child rather than looping.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: animated-shiny-text
components.title: Animated Shiny Text
components.description: A light glare effect which pans across text making it appear as if it is shimmering.
components.reviewDescription: A narrow light sheen sweeps across otherwise stable text.
components.interaction: The sheen repeats automatically across the text.

motionProfile.mechanism: CSS background-position sends a narrow sheen across clipped text.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Eight-second repeating sweep.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: animated-grid-pattern
components.title: Animated Grid Pattern
components.description: A animated background grid pattern made with SVGs, fully customizable using Tailwind CSS.
components.reviewDescription: An SVG grid where individual squares fade in and out, then reappear at new random positions.
components.interaction: Squares animate in staggered loops and relocate after each cycle; the grid responds to container resizing.

motionProfile.mechanism: SVG squares fade in, fade out, then get assigned new random positions.
motionProfile.trigger: Starts on mount and reacts to container resize.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Each square performs a staggered two-pass reveal; the next cycle changes positions.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: border-beam
components.title: Border Beam
components.description: An animated beam of light which travels along the border of its container.
components.reviewDescription: A short bright beam travels around a container’s border.
components.interaction: The beam loops around the perimeter; direction and speed are configurable.

motionProfile.mechanism: A bright segment moves along an SVG/path-like offset path around the host border.
motionProfile.trigger: Starts on mount; reverse, delay, and transition can be configured.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Linear infinite loop, six-second default.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: animated-beam
components.title: Animated Beam
components.description: An animated beam of light which travels along a path. Useful for showcasing the integration features of a website.
components.reviewDescription: Animated connector paths link supplied elements to illustrate relationships or data flow.
components.interaction: Beams travel along the paths between referenced DOM nodes; resize and layout affect the paths.

motionProfile.mechanism: An SVG linear-gradient highlight travels along a path connecting referenced elements.
motionProfile.trigger: Starts on mount after optional delay; path recalculates with layout/resize.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Repeated beam travel along the connector; easing and duration are configurable.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: text-reveal
components.title: Text Reveal
components.description: Fade in text as you scroll down the page.
components.reviewDescription: Text color is revealed progressively according to page scroll progress.
components.interaction: Scroll through the text to advance the reveal.

motionProfile.mechanism: Text changes from muted to foreground color according to scroll progress through its container.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Scroll-linked reveal; not a timed typewriter.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: hyper-text
components.title: Hyper Text
components.description: A text animation that scrambles letters before revealing the final text.
components.reviewDescription: Characters scramble or swap before settling into the target word.
components.interaction: Hover or activate the text to trigger the scramble-and-resolve effect.

motionProfile.mechanism: Characters are repeatedly replaced by random glyphs until each position resolves to the target text.
motionProfile.trigger: Hover by default; can start on view or be configured otherwise.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Finite scramble sequence per trigger; optional repeat behavior.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: animated-gradient-text
components.title: Animated Gradient Text
components.description: An animated gradient background which transitions between colors for text.
components.reviewDescription: Text uses a moving gradient fill that shifts between configured colors.
components.interaction: The color gradient loops automatically behind the letterforms.

motionProfile.mechanism: Clipped text gradient shifts its background position across configured colors.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Eight-second linear infinite loop.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: orbiting-circles
components.title: Orbiting Circles
components.description: A collection of circles which move in orbit along a circular path
components.reviewDescription: Small elements travel around a shared circular center.
components.interaction: Orbits animate automatically; set radius, direction, and child elements.

motionProfile.mechanism: Each child is positioned on a radius and rotated around a shared center while counter-rotation keeps its orientation upright.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Continuous linear CSS orbit; direction, radius, speed, and delay are configurable.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: dock
components.title: Dock
components.description: An implementation of the MacOS dock using react + tailwindcss + motion
components.reviewDescription: A row of icons grows and shifts based on pointer distance, like a desktop dock.
components.interaction: Move across the icons to trigger proximity scaling and spring movement.

motionProfile.mechanism: Pointer proximity drives spring-scaled icons and neighboring spacing, like a desktop dock.
motionProfile.trigger: Pointer moves across the dock; leaving resets the distance field.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Interactive spring response; no autonomous loop.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: word-rotate
components.title: Word Rotate
components.description: A vertical rotation of words
components.reviewDescription: A vertical slot rotates through a list of words or phrases.
components.interaction: Words change on a timer with a vertical transition.

motionProfile.mechanism: One word exits upward while the next enters from below with opacity and vertical translation.
motionProfile.trigger: A timer advances through the word list.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Repeated interval; default transition is 250 ms ease-out.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: avatar-circles
components.title: Avatar Circles
components.description: Overlapping circles of avatars.
components.reviewDescription: A compact overlapping stack of supplied avatar images.
components.interaction: Static display; provide real, approved portraits and optional overflow count.

motionProfile.mechanism: Static overlapping avatar stack with optional overflow count.
motionProfile.lifecycle: No motion; uses supplied images.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: typing-animation
components.title: Typing Animation
components.description: Characters appearing in typed animation
components.reviewDescription: Text appears character by character, optionally followed by a cursor.
components.interaction: The typewriter sequence starts when configured or when the element enters view.

motionProfile.mechanism: Characters are revealed in sequence; optional cursor blinks, and multiple words/lines can be sequenced.
motionProfile.trigger: Starts immediately or when in view according to props.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Finite typing sequence; cursor uses a repeating blink.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: sparkles-text
components.title: Sparkles Text
components.description: A dynamic text that generates continuous sparkles with smooth transitions, perfect for highlighting text with animated stars.
components.reviewDescription: Small star-like particles appear and fade around emphasized text.
components.interaction: Sparkles are generated repeatedly around the text while mounted.

motionProfile.mechanism: Small SVG star particles are placed around the text, drift/scale, and fade in and out.
motionProfile.trigger: Starts on mount; star positions refresh periodically.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Particles repeat their short opacity/scale cycles.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: spinning-text
components.title: Spinning Text
components.description: The Spinning Text component animates text in a circular motion with customizable speed, direction, color, and transitions for dynamic and engaging effects.
components.reviewDescription: Characters follow a circular path and rotate around a center.
components.interaction: The circular lettering rotates continuously at a configurable speed and direction.

motionProfile.mechanism: Characters are individually placed around a circular path; the group rotates as one.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Linear infinite rotation; ten-second default duration.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: flip-text
components.title: Flip Text
components.description: Text flipping character animation
components.reviewDescription: Characters flip through a vertical or 3D transition to reveal replacement text.
components.interaction: A text change triggers per-character flipping; current public registry source is unresolved.

motionProfile.mechanism: Official v3 docs describe a character-by-character flip when the displayed text changes, with a configurable duration and stagger delay.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Finite staggered transition; current source is unavailable, so exact transform and replay behavior are docs-only.
motionProfile.evidence: official v3 docs only; current implementation source unavailable

components.name: comic-text
components.title: Comic Text
components.description: Comic text animation
components.reviewDescription: Text enters with a playful, elastic comic-book style motion.
components.interaction: The entrance animation runs when rendered; its exaggerated style is attention-grabbing.

motionProfile.mechanism: Text fades in while scaling from 0.8 and rotating slightly, with an overshooting ease.
motionProfile.lifecycle: One 600 ms entrance; no repeating motion.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: icon-cloud
components.title: Icon Cloud
components.description: An interactive 3D tag cloud component
components.reviewDescription: Icons are laid out in a manipulable 3D cloud that responds to pointer movement.
components.interaction: Drag or move across the cloud to rotate and explore its icons.

motionProfile.mechanism: Icons are drawn on a canvas sphere that slowly rotates; pointer movement changes rotation, and drag gives direct control.
motionProfile.trigger: Auto-rotates until paused; pointer drag directly turns it.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Continuous canvas loop by default; pause button stops idle rotation.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: text-animate
components.title: Text Animate
components.description: A text animation component that animates text using a variety of different animations.
components.reviewDescription: A text wrapper offering several entrance and emphasis animations for its child text.
components.interaction: Choose the animation preset and trigger behavior; presets may run on mount or while in view.

motionProfile.mechanism: Selectable Motion presets animate child words/characters through opacity, position, scale, blur, and stagger variants.
motionProfile.trigger: On mount or in-view depending on props; may be one-shot.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Finite entrance/effect sequence; exact movement depends on chosen preset.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: scroll-based-velocity
components.title: Scroll Based Velocity
components.description: Scrolling text whose speed changes based on scroll speed
components.reviewDescription: A scrolling text track whose speed and direction react to scroll velocity.
components.interaction: Scroll faster or reverse direction to change the track’s movement.

motionProfile.mechanism: A duplicated text track translates continuously; scroll velocity changes its speed and direction.
motionProfile.lifecycle: Scroll-linked velocity; track continues moving between scroll input.
motionProfile.evidence: checked against the local official component source snapshot

components.name: scratch-to-reveal
components.title: Scratch To Reveal
components.description: The ScratchToReveal component creates an interactive scratch-off effect with customizable dimensions and animations, revealing hidden content beneath.
components.reviewDescription: A scratch-off surface reveals content beneath it as the user drags.
components.interaction: Drag or touch across the overlay to erase/reveal; current public registry source is unresolved.

motionProfile.mechanism: Official v3 docs describe a pointer/touch scratch mask that erases to reveal child content and calls onComplete at a scratched-area threshold.
motionProfile.trigger: Drag or touch across the surface.
motionProfile.lifecycle: User-driven finite reveal; default completion threshold 50%; source was removed from current registry.
motionProfile.evidence: official v3 docs only; current implementation source unavailable

components.name: shiny-button
